_meta.notes: No flag was carried for this filing and none is needed on the label: cover, Summary Page and both schedule stubs all agree with the chunk file (BEN McADAMS, Mayor, Year-End, 2016 form). Findings at the page: (a) SIGNATURE DATE - the cover reads '1/31/' then a struck-over '16' replaced by '17'; recorded as 1/31/17, which is corroborated by the RECEIVED stamp JAN 31 2017 and by the '1/31/2017' Date of Report printed in the header box of pages 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6. The year on this cover is a filer self-correction, not an ambiguity. (b) NEITHER amendment box (Yes/No) is checked, so is_amendment is honestly blank. (c) The cover's address block is a real BLACK REDACTION BAR (redacted at source), and the phone/fax/email cells are blank. (d) SHAPE: both sides are attachment-behind-stub - the county Schedule A (p3) and Schedule B (p5) pages are present, each carrying only the handwritten words 'See attached schedule' / 'see attached schedule' and the grand total, with the filer's own spreadsheet behind. (e) ROTATION IS PER PAGE, NOT PER FILING: p4 (contributions) is stored ROTATED 90 degrees inside the PDF and had to be rotated to read, while p6 (expenditures) renders upright. Both were read at 400 dpi. All geometry is expressed against the page AS POPPLER RENDERS IT (portrait), so a contributions row is a narrow VERTICAL strip on p4 and an expenditures row a horizontal band on p6. (f) OCCUPATION: the contributions attachment splits the county form's single 'Occupation/Employer' column into TWO columns, 'Employer' and 'Occupation'. The occupation field here is the two cells joined verbatim as '<Occupation> / <Employer>', in the order of the county column's own name; neither cell is normalized. 20 of 29 rows carry occupation content; the 9 blanks are all organizations/PACs/funds where the filer left both cells empty. (g) PRIVACY: the attachment's Address, City, State and Zip columns are covered by ONE continuous black bar across all 29 rows - redacted at source. Nothing was read from under it and no geography is recorded. (h) There is NO in-kind column and no in-kind marker anywhere in either attachment, so in_kind is false on every row - a source limit, not a finding. (i) One expenditure row (11/15/2016 Shell Oil) is printed out of date order between two 11/09/2016 rows; the filer's spelling 'PA Equioment' and recipient 'Loftes Grill' are kept verbatim.

contributions.detail: The 29 attachment rows sum to 21,985.00 EXACTLY. Three printed figures agree with that sum and with each other: the attachment's own foot ('Sum: $21,985.00'), the county Schedule A stub's TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (21,985.00), and Summary line 1 Column A (21,985.00). Summary line 4 carries the same figure. No schedule-total-vs-summary-gap here: there are no in-kind rows and the two anchors are identical.

expenditures.detail: The 52 attachment rows sum to 80,520.46 EXACTLY, matching the attachment's own printed foot ($ 80,520.46), the county Schedule B stub's TOTAL EXPENDITUTRES MADE (80,520.46), and Summary line 2 Column A (80,520.46). Summary line 6 carries the same figure.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: NEITHER county stub page prints a usable SUBTOTAL FOR THIS PAGE - both subtotal cells are printed and LEFT BLANK while the grand-total cell below carries the figure (the documented 'subtotal printed but blank' case). The attachments print no per-page subtotal either; each is a single page ending in its own grand total. So the available gate is the schedule/attachment GRAND TOTAL, and both sides gate on it exactly: p4 rows 21,985.00 = attachment foot 21,985.00 = p3 stub total 21,985.00; p6 rows 80,520.46 = attachment foot 80,520.46 = p5 stub total 80,520.46.
